# D&D 5e API test fixtures

These fixtures prepare the future MSW integration for controlled tests against `dnd5eapi.co` response shapes.

- They are local test data and do not depend on internet access.
- They do not replace `dnd5eapi.co` as the canonical SRD source.
- They must not be used to resolve combat rules or campaign state.
- They are only for tests and future MSW handlers.
- They must not introduce non-5e systems, THAC0, descending AC, retro saving throw tables, morale systems, or alternate XP economies.
- They do not decide mechanics; backend rules code remains authoritative.
